statusMeaning.healthy: manifest.generated.json matches nexus-manifest.json on every shared component (0 prop/type/union diffs) and the unmodified validar.mjs still passes every POC screen against it — safe to build new screens from manifest.generated.json (superset: 46 components vs 32).
statusMeaning.warning: either a POC screen regressed against manifest.generated.json, or the diff surfaced a probable extractor bug — /studio should fall back to nexus-manifest.json (32 components, hand-verified) until a human reviews nexus-contract/report.md.
statusMeaning.stale: the mirror under scripts/nexus-contract/.mirror predates a monorepo change and has not been refreshed — re-run `node fetch-mirror.mjs && node run-audit.mjs` before trusting these numbers.
